note: No-GPS route call-outs (goto.routeCalledBy). Every voice covers left/right x {street}/{avenue} (UI test tests/ui-route.test.ts). The HUD prints the computed turn; a voiced line plays only if its direction and slot match.

lines.text: Left on {street}.
Right on {street}, then straight.
Hang a left on {avenue}.
Right on {avenue}. Keep going.
Here. Right here. Pull over.
You missed it! Go around the block. {street}'s one way.
The map says left? On, um, {street}?
Right on {street}, I think. Is that a street or an avenue?
Left onto {avenue}? The book says it's very long.
Right on {avenue}! Look, honey, the big one!
Oh! That's it! That's the building!
Hang a left on {street}, kid.
Right on {street}. Easy. Mind the hydrant.
Left on {avenue}. Faster than it looks.
Swing right on {avenue}. Ride the lights.
Broadway does what it wants. Stay on {avenue}.
Pull up by the hydrant. Nobody tickets a hack at the hydrant.
Left. On {street}. Hurry. Please hurry.
Right on {street}! Right! Don't brake so hard!
Left on {avenue}. Breathe. Breathe and drive.
Right on {avenue}. Pennington's on Ninth. Go!
Slowly, Mr. Arce. Left at {street}. I'm in no hurry. You are.
Right on {street}. Mind the old man on the corner. That's me in ten years.
Left onto {avenue}, if you please.
Right on {avenue}. Gently. I'm not a sack of laundry.
Left on {street}. Rule nine: never the obvious way.
Right on {street}. Quick, before the light.
Left on {avenue}. Nobody watches the left.
Rule nine: never take {avenue} after midnight. Right on it anyway.
Left on {street}! I own a building on this block, I should know.
Right on {street}. My first shop was here. Smaller than this car.
Left on {avenue}! No, here! Yes, here!
Right on {avenue}. Everybody gets paid on {avenue}.

voiceNote: Keyed by the passenger's cast id. 'side.baby_cab' overrides to 'labour' for that quest only. Leads riding as passengers in another lead's car use their own voice.
